reasoning: The Dashboard implements responsive design across all three breakpoints with strong fundamentals. Mobile layout (<640px) fully complies with vertical KPI stacking and scrollable table. Tablet layout (640-1024px) shows 2x2 KPI grid and adapted navigation. However, there's a breakpoint alignment issue: the implementation uses xl (1280px) for desktop 4-column layout instead of lg (1024px) as specified, creating a 256px gap where the layout is suboptimal. All core responsive patterns are present (grid-cols responsive classes, overflow-x-auto, responsive spacing), but the breakpoint mismatch prevents full compliance with the >1024px desktop requirement. Total: 26/34 points.
